title: Ordinary coefficient reduction preserves pullback composition
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with completed coefficient sheaves [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Fix system operations $o$ and section-normalized compositors $c$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations], and an ordinary limit model $a$ [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. For a scheme $W$, write $Q_W$ for ordinary whole-system coefficient reduction. For a scheme map $f:X\to Y$, write $P_f^{\rm ring}$ and $P_f^{\rm sys}$ for ordinary module pullbacks on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $\delta_f:Q_XP_f^{\rm ring}\simeq P_f^{\rm sys}Q_Y$ for the adjoint conjugate of the ordinary limit comparison specified by $a$. For composable maps $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$, let $\gamma_{f,g}:P_{fg}^{\rm ring}\simeq P_f^{\rm ring}P_g^{\rm ring}$ be the adjoint conjugate of the unique direct-image compositor whose section map is restriction along the canonical iterated-pullback isomorphism [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Then for every completed-coefficient module sheaf $M$ on $Z$, $P_f^{\rm sys}(\delta_g(M))\circ\delta_f(P_g^{\rm ring}M)\circ Q_X(\gamma_{f,g}(M))=c^{\rm ordinary}_{f,g}(Q_ZM)\circ\delta_{fg}(M)$. This is an equality of maps of whole ordinary strict systems; no derived category or chosen resolution occurs.

proof.text: Postcompose the ordinary direct-image/limit composites with each projection of the limit after completed direct image. The direct image is a right adjoint and preserves this limit. The projection formula from OrdinaryLimitModel.projections identifies each projected section with the original finite section. The two direct-image compositors restrict along the same pullbackComp map by Compositors.sections and modulePushComposition_existsUnique. Naturality of the projection moves this restriction across the projection. Thus all projections agree, and their joint monicity proves the direct-image/limit composition equation.

proof.text: Conjugate this equality by the ordinary reduction/limit and pullback/direct-image adjunctions. Expand conjugation of composition, whiskering and associators using the standard conjugateIsoEquiv identities. OrdinaryLimitModel.reductionPull is the conjugate of comparison, and c.conjugate identifies the other compositor. Taking components gives the asserted ordinary quotient/pullback equality.

theorem ordinaryReductionPullComposition
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (o : Operations l E) (a : OrdinaryLimitModel l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (M : scalarReductionSource l E Z) :
    (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E X).map
        (((conjugateIsoEquiv
          ((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Z)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull g)).comp
          (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)))
          (proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction (f ≫ g) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Z)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
            ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull (f ≫ g)))).symm
          (PurCompactSupport.modulePushComposition_existsUnique
            (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f g
            (PurCompactSupport.completedPull_comp l E f g)).exists.choose).hom.app M) ≫
        (a.reductionPull l E f).hom.app ((integralOrdinaryPull l E g).obj M) ≫
        (pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).map ((a.reductionPull l E g).hom.app M) =
      (a.reductionPull l E (f ≫ g)).hom.app M ≫
        (c.ordinaryPull f g).hom.app ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Z).obj M)
